title: dactylorhiza sphagnicola subsp. sennia
intro: Dactylorhiza sphagnicola subsp. sennia, commonly known as the Sennia Marsh Orchid, is a rare and endangered subspecies of orchid native to the marshy areas of Europe and North Africa. It belongs to the genus Dactylorhiza, which is a group of terrestrial orchids characterized by their yellow or greenish flowers. The Sennia Marsh Orchid has been used in traditional medicine, particularly for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
